comparison.objective: Stand and mount a filament spool onto a holder rod; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-hand lifting, bore-to-rod alignment and sliding insertion versus small-tool engagement, collar adjustment and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Spool reaches the rod stop without jamming versus two force-, travel- and rebound-compliant impact cycles.
comparison.reason: Large-object bimanual insertion is materially different from fine adjustment followed by dynamic performance testing.
